failed_attempt.cause: The first full-browser harness sent do=import instead of action=import to the MCP bookmarks tool. It listed an empty tree instead of importing; corrected without an application change.

limitations: The full browser used a fresh application with the previously accepted 4548921 PDF engine and published822 dependencies, not a newly published package.
Native editor Save behavior was checked in a hidden window; its layout was not visually inspected.
Firefox descriptions removed from the source database cannot be recovered; modern Firefox may omit annotation tables.
